subject: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot

Team — quick context: Atlas Health (pilot customer) just asked for a short, isolated slice of Dedicated capacity for a live demo next week. They want a predictable demo window (low latency, stable throughput) and are asking we avoid preemption during the demo — effectively an ephemeral slate / soft waiver of our autoscale eviction policy for the slot.

Why this matters: this demo is the last checkpoint before a potential reserved commitment (discussed in HubSpot). If we can deliver a clean demo it materially increases the probability of a multi-month Dedicated contract.

Ask: can we (1) grant a temporary exemption from eviction for a bounded window, (2) assign a product-priority tag so the request routes to the right GPU pool, and (3) confirm billing/credit handling?

Traffic & timeline: attached is Atlas' forecast for the demo (~2–3k low-latency tokens/min peak, 20 concurrent sessions) — demo target window is Tue 2026-09-22 10:00–13:00 PDT. We're proposing a 72-hour ephemeral window for preflight + demo (start: Mon 2026-09-21 08:00 PDT). If 72 hours is too large, please propose the minimum safe window.

Constraints to call out: scheduled maintenance is planned in the US-west pool on 2026-09-23, so we likely need to avoid interfering with that.

Attachments: atlas-traffic-forecast-sep16.csv

Next steps: Kimberly / Marcus — can you confirm feasibility and required guardrails (max slice size, eviction override mechanism, telemetry hooks)? Aditya — can you weigh in on the product-side ask (priority tag + rollout policy)? Hannah — if we approve, can you prepare the billing note / credits template so Sales can present terms to Atlas?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot

Thanks Laura — short answers up front:
- Feasibility: probably yes, but need to scope exact resource footprint (model + token rate).
- Window: Ops prefers 48h over 72h for waivers unless there's a clear business ask.
- Maintenance conflict: we can avoid the maintenance by shifting demo earlier on 09-22 or giving Atlas a reserved lane that doesn’t touch the maintenance host pool.

Questions for Marcus: what is the minimum GPU slice (gpus / slots) we should reserve for 20 concurrent sessions on the requested model? Also, what telemetry do we need enabled to validate the demo runs (logs / tail sampling)?

Aditya — any objection to a 48h waiver and product-priority routing?

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Dedicated Capacity Operations
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot

Laura / team — dug into the forecast. Technical notes:
- Model & footprint: Atlas will use the rdx-13b-quant variant (kv-cache enabled). For 20 concurrent sessions at 2.5k tokens/min peak, safe baseline is a 2-GPU slice with continuous batching tuned to 32ms tail target.
- Minimum safe window: 36 hours + 4 hours preflight/pipeline warmup (40h total) gives us enough time to warm KV cache and validate monitoring. If Sales insists on 72h we can do it but we need explicit sign-off from capacity schedulers.
- Eviction waiver: Ops can apply a soft-exemption tag that prevents preemption but still allows manual reclaim if there's a hard emergency. I will not recommend a hard absolute immunity.
- Telemetry: enable token-level latency traces, per-slot CPU/GPU utilization, and prefix cache hit-rate sampling. We should stream logs to the demo-specific workspace.

I've attached the waiver template with the operational checkboxes filled for a 48-hour soft exemption. Please review.

Attachments: ephemeral-waiver-template.docx

I'll volunteer to be on-call during the window to help triage.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Capacity Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Smita Rao <smita@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot

Smita — looping you in with the ops ask and proposed plan. TL;DR: Ops can support a 48-hour soft-exemption (plus 4 hours warmup) rather than the 72h window we initially suggested. That gives us a 52-hour total window. Marcus will be on-call for the demo.

Can you confirm (a) whether Atlas can compress preflight into the shorter window and (b) whether you still need the 72h buffer for internal rehearsals? If you need the 72h we can escalate to schedulers but will need a stronger justification.

If you confirm we will send a short waiver doc and the billing note (Hannah will follow with credits language).

Best,
Laura
From: Smita Rao <smita@atlashealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ephemeral slate waiver & product priority for Atlas Health pilot

Thanks Laura and team — appreciate the quick turnaround. We can compress rehearsals into the 48h + warmup window you proposed. We'll aim to do preflight on Mon 09-21 (afternoon PT) and run the demo Tue 09-22 09:30–11:30 PT. The extra 2 hours on your end for warmup works for us.

Please send the waiver doc and any billing/credit wording and we'll confirm on our side. Looking forward to a smooth demo.

-Smita Rao
Director of Integrations, Atlas Health
smita@atlashealth.com
